title: Angelyse Mariah does not hold back in her recent track “Corny Text”
htmlContent:
American Based music star Angelyse Mariah is a talented singer and songwriter who is taking over the industry by storm. Her lyrics, production, and vocal delivery all come together to create a powerful, empowering message that will resonate with many. This trait is displayed in her recent "Corny Text."

Angelyse Mariah's "Corny Text" is her 6th release. This track shows more of her edgy personality, fused with some base to give it more of a hip-hop trap feel that keeps her fans coming back for more. Being a Bi-lingual artist who speaks Spanish and English, she doesn't hold back as she takes us on a journey we don't want to return.
